university.name: Manchester Metropolitan University
university.summary: A university in Manchester that publishes a dedicated page for applicants from Pakistan, covering foundation, undergraduate and postgraduate taught entry routes, with English language requirements stated by level. International scholarships are assessed automatically at admission.
university.eligibility_note: Listed on the gov.uk register of licensed student sponsors (Student route, Higher Education Institution, no action plan flag), register dated 2026-09-18

courses.title: Management
courses.duration_text: One year of study (stated in the course description; no course length field shown)
courses.overview: A full-time taught master's in management covering strategy, marketing, supply chain operations, innovation and project management, finance for managers and ethical leadership, finishing with a management project.
highlights: Management Project (all listed as Year 1 core modules)
courses.academic_requirements: Typical offer: lower second-class UK honours degree (2:2). For Pakistan, see the Pakistan entry note.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS 6.5 overall (course page). General postgraduate taught guidance: IELTS 6.5 with no component below 5.5; PTE Academic 65 with no component below 59; TOEFL iBT 89 (Listening 17, Reading 18, Speaking 20, Writing 17); Duolingo 120 with no component below 100.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Bachelor's degree must be from an HEC recognised university. 4-year bachelor's: 2.7/4.0 to 3.0/4.0, or 2.5 to 2.8 with at least 2 years' relevant work experience. 2-year bachelor's plus 2-year master's: 2.7/4.0 to 3.0/4.0, or 55% to 60%. The page gives ranges, so no single minimum is recorded.
courses.notes: Fee page does not state the academic year; the international tuition page for 2026-27 gives a postgraduate taught range of GBP 21,000 to 22,500 and no 2027-28 figures. Sub-band, PTE, TOEFL and Duolingo values are from the general English language requirements page, not the course page.

courses.academic_requirements: Lower second-class UK honours degree (2:2). For Pakistan, see the Pakistan entry note.

courses.pakistan_entry_note: Bachelor's degree must be from an HEC recognised university. 4-year bachelor's: 2.7/4.0 to 3.0/4.0, or 2.5 to 2.8 with at least 2 years' relevant work experience. 2-year bachelor's plus 2-year master's: 2.7/4.0 to 3.0/4.0, or 55% to 60%. courses.title: Master of Business Administration
courses.duration_text: Not stated on the course page
courses.overview: A taught MBA offered full-time and part-time, with ten Year 1 modules spanning strategy, marketing, leadership, corporate finance, entrepreneurship, operations and business analytics.
highlights: Dynamic Strategies for a Changing World
Consultancy in Action (all listed as Year 1 core modules)
courses.academic_requirements: Lower second-class UK honours degree (2:2) and 3 years experience. For Pakistan, see the Pakistan entry note.
courses.english_requirements: Not stated on the course page. The general English language requirements page lists MA and MSc postgraduate taught requirements but does not name the MBA.
courses.experience_requirements: 3 years experience (as stated on the course page)
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Bachelor's degree must be from an HEC recognised university. 4-year bachelor's: 2.7/4.0 to 3.0/4.0, or 2.5 to 2.8 with at least 2 years' relevant work experience. The page gives ranges, so no single minimum is recorded.
courses.notes: English requirement for the MBA and course duration are not shown on the course page. Full-time fee GBP 31,000 per year, part-time GBP 31,000 in total (GBP 15,500 per year); fee year not stated.

scholarships.name: Undergraduate International Scholarship
scholarships.value_text: GBP 2,000 for each year of the degree (funded for 120 credits per year, up to 3 years for a bachelor's or 4 years for an integrated master's or foundation year route)
scholarships.summary: A tuition fee reduction for new self-funding overseas-fee undergraduates on eligible Manchester campus courses. No separate application; eligibility is assessed at admission.
scholarships.criteria_text: Hold an offer for a full-time taught undergraduate programme, be self-funding and classed as overseas for fee purposes, and be a new student. Manchester School of Architecture programmes and the UAL Foundation Diploma are excluded. Cannot be combined with other university discounts.
scholarships.deadline_note: No separate application or deadline stated
scholarships.notes: Amount is from the scholarships listing page; the terms page states no amount and its title says 2026/27 while its heading says 2027/28. Deferred entry does not carry the award over.

scholarships.name: Postgraduate International Scholarship
scholarships.value_text: GBP 5,000 off year one tuition for most eligible taught master's courses, GBP 3,000 for selected programmes including the MBA
scholarships.summary: A first-year tuition reduction for self-funding overseas-fee students holding an offer for an eligible taught master's course on the Manchester campus. No separate application.
scholarships.criteria_text: Hold an offer for a 180 credit taught master's, be self-funding and classed as overseas for fee purposes. Diplomas, certificates, the PGCE, LLM Legal Practice and MSc Place Management and Leadership are excluded. Cannot be combined with other university discounts.
scholarships.deadline_note: No separate application or deadline stated
scholarships.notes: Terms page covers programmes starting September 2026 or January 2027 only. The scholarships listing page shows no September 2027 postgraduate award yet.

scholarships.name: Business School International Postgraduate Scholarship
scholarships.value_text: GBP 5,000 in the first year of study
scholarships.summary: A first-year fee reduction for self-funding overseas-fee students holding an offer for a taught master's delivered by the Business School. No separate application.
scholarships.criteria_text: Hold an offer for a 180 credit taught master's delivered by the Business School on the Manchester campus, be self-funding and classed as overseas. MBA and postgraduate diplomas or certificates are excluded.
scholarships.deadline_note: No separate application or deadline stated
scholarships.notes: The scholarships listing page also shows this award for September 2027 entry, but the terms page names only September 2026 and January 2027 programmes. Client should confirm September 2027 coverage.
